Game Overview

At its heart, Ink Ball Run is a puzzle game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Getting started in Ink Ball Run doesn't take long to learn. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Ink Ball Run?

Ink Ball Run is a free puzzle game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Ink Ball Run free to play?

Yes, Ink Ball Run is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
